author: The Infographics Show
description:
What if a modern drug cartel had one mission - to get contraband past the Great Wall of China?

From massive underground tunnels and medieval-style catapults to drones, ultralight aircraft, and even human mules, cartels have proven there’s almost no barrier they won’t try to bypass.
Some methods are clever, others are insane, but all of them push the limits of what’s possible.

This episode breaks down the wildest ways a cartel could try to beat one of history’s most iconic defenses, and which methods might actually work.

Because when there’s profit on the line, no wall is truly untouchable.

CHAPTERS:
0:34 - Tunnel Under the Great Wall
3:27 - Catapults and Narco Cannons
5:56 - Ultralights and Drones
9:07 - Fireworks and Rocket Ideas
10:31 - Human Mules and Hidden Drugs
14:00 - Water Routes and Bribery
16:31 - Cartel vs. Ming Troops

Narrated by: Josh Risser
